messages:
maria (compliance): Heads-up: quarterly least-privilege sweep scheduled next Tue. We need an evidence bag (IAM snapshots, KMS grant history, recent key usage) and a rollback/canary for admin removals. Who can take what?

axel (sec-eng): I can own KMS checks and rebind playbook. We found last quarter that cross-account grants existed on a couple keys; prefer to rebind to a specific deploy svcacct before any role pruning.

priya (infra): Current prod log retention is 90 days. For compliance evidence we should export to long-term storage (BQ or S3 with 1y retention). I can enable a pipeline but need a scheduled window (no evening deploys). Example sink command: 

  gcloud logging sinks create audit-longterm bigquery.googleapis.com/projects/redwood-prod/datasets/audit --log-filter="resource.type=\"k8s_container\""

(tweak for AWS CloudWatch -> S3 similarly)

lee (sre): I'll prepare the dry-run prune list. My heuristic: roles with owner=null and lastUsed > 120d OR no recent grants. I'll produce a CSV with role, last_used, owners, attached_keys. Dry-run only, post in PR.

maria (compliance): Add a column for "justification_tag" and a link to the evidence blob. We need manual attestation for any role that looks risky.

axel (sec-eng): KMS rebind pattern I propose: create a dedicated principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-deploy-limited with kms:Decrypt only, and replace external principals. Diff example: 

  - Sid: ExternalDeployGrant
    Principal: arn:aws:iam::999999999999:role/old-agent
  + Sid: DeploySvcAcctGrant
    Principal: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-deploy-limited

We should run decrypt smoke tests afterwards (simulate deploy).

audit-bot: queued export: types=[iam_snapshot,kms_grants,key_usage] window=365d output=gs://redwood-audit/1716321000-evidence.tar.gz ETA=3m

tara (oncall): Tue 10:00 PT works for me. I'll put guardrails in the playbook: pause if >0.5% of decrypt ops error or if any deploy job fails. Add immediate rollback steps (rebind back).

priya (infra): I'll flip the sink Mon night and confirm in this thread once export done. Will annotate the export with lifecycle policy (s3: Glacier after 30d).

lee (sre): Dry-run CSV ready by EOD Mon. Will tag owners and mark entries with 'shelve' vs 'remove' flags. 'shelve' = remove permissions but keep role for 30d in case of fallout.

maria (compliance): Love the shelve idea. For audit, please include a short owner-provided justification on shelfed items. We'll collect signatures in the ticket.

axel (sec-eng): After rebind, I'll run a 48h monitoring job: track DecryptErrors, KeyNotFound, and deploy failure counts. Script will output a quick healthstamp.

audit-bot: export complete. Summary: ownerless_roles=9, kms_cross_account_grants=2, stale_keys=1. Evidence blob: gs://redwood-audit/1716321000-evidence.tar.gz :white_check_mark:

maria (compliance): Thanks. I'll open the tracker, add required artifacts and acceptance criteria. Action items recap: priya -> long-term sink, lee -> dry-run CSV + PR, axel -> KMS rebind plan + smoke tests, tara -> canary window + rollback steps, audit-bot -> evidence blob (done).
